question: Who among the following is the Indian actor who was felicitated/honoured by the European Chambers of Commerce on May 17, 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Kapoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anil Kapoor is a prominent Indian actor and producer known for his works in Bollywood.
 
• He has been honored with several awards for his contributions to Indian cinema, including six Filmfare Awards and two National Film Awards.
 
• On May 17, 2019, Anil Kapoor was felicitated by the European Chambers of Commerce for his exceptional contribution to Indian cinema and his influence on international cinema.
 
• His career has spanned over four decades, and he has appeared in more than 100 films, including international projects like "Slumdog Millionaire" and the TV series "24".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **European Chambers of Commerce:**

 
 
• The European Chambers of Commerce are organizations that represent the interests of businesses in Europe.
 
• They provide a platform for businesses to collaborate, share best practices, and advocate for policies that promote economic growth and development.
 
• These chambers often recognize and honor individuals and organizations that have made significant contributions to their respective fields.
 
 
 
• **Bollywood:**
 
 
• Bollywood is the Indian Hindi-language film industry based in Mumbai (formerly Bombay).
 
• It is one of the largest film industries in the world in terms of the number of films produced and tickets sold.
 
• Bollywood is known for its vibrant music, colorful dance sequences, and diverse storytelling.
 
 
 
• **Slumdog Millionaire:**
 
 
• Slumdog Millionaire is a 2008 British drama film directed by Danny Boyle.
 
• The film is based on the novel "Q & A" by Indian author Vikas Swarup.
 
• It won eight Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Adapted Screenplay.
 
• Anil Kapoor played the role of the game show host in the film.
 
 
 
• **Filmfare Awards:**
 
 
• The Filmfare Awards are one of the most prestigious film awards in India.
 
• They were first introduced in 1954 by The Times Group to honor artistic and technical excellence in the Hindi-language film industry.
 
• Anil Kapoor has won multiple Filmfare Awards throughout his career.
